hebrewText: כֹּהֲנֶ֜י/הָ חָמְס֣וּ תוֹרָתִ/י֮ וַ/יְחַלְּל֣וּ קָדָשַׁ/י֒ בֵּֽין קֹ֤דֶשׁ לְ/חֹל֙ לֹ֣א הִבְדִּ֔ילוּ וּ/בֵין הַ/טָּמֵ֥א לְ/טָה֖וֹר לֹ֣א הוֹדִ֑יעוּ וּ/מִ/שַׁבְּתוֹתַ/י֙ הֶעְלִ֣ימוּ עֵֽינֵי/הֶ֔ם וָ/אֵחַ֖ל בְּ/תוֹכָֽ/ם

tokens.bdb: literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)
tokens.kjv: chief ruler, [idiom] own, priest, prince, principal officer.

tokens.bdb: to be violent; by implication, to maltreat
tokens.kjv: make bare, shake off, violate, do violence, take away violently, wrong, imagine wrongfully.

tokens.bdb: a precept or statute, especially the Decalogue or Pentateuch
tokens.kjv: law.

tokens.bdb: properly, to bore, i.e. (by implication) to wound, to dissolve; figuratively, to profane (a person, place or thing), to break (one's word), to begin (as if by an 'opening wedge'); to play (the flute)
tokens.kjv: begin ([idiom] men began), defile, [idiom] break, defile, [idiom] eat (as common things), [idiom] first, [idiom] gather the grape thereof, [idiom] take inheritance, pipe, player on instruments, pollute, (cast as) profane (self), prostitute, slay (slain), sorrow, stain, wound.

tokens.bdb: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
tokens.kjv: consecrated (thing), dedicated (thing), hallowed (thing), holiness, ([idiom] most) holy ([idiom] day, portion, thing), saint, sanctuary.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.enLiteralWord: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.explanation: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.explanationEn: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract

tokens.bdb: between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or
tokens.kjv: among, asunder, at, between (-twixt...and), [phrase] from (the widest), [idiom] in, out of, whether (it be...or), within.
tokens.explanation: ben — entre, no meio de, no espaço que separa

tokens.bdb: properly, exposed; hence, profane
tokens.kjv: common, profane (place), unholy.

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.
tokens.explanation: lo — negação absoluta em hebraico: não, nunca, jamais

tokens.bdb: to divide (in variation senses literally or figuratively, separate, distinguish, differ, select, etc.)
tokens.kjv: (make, put) difference, divide (asunder), (make) separate (self, -ation), sever (out), [idiom] utterly.
tokens.enLiteralWord: to divide (in variation senses literally or figuratively
tokens.explanation: badal — separar, dividir, distinguir entre duas coisas
tokens.explanationEn: to divide (in variation senses literally or figuratively

tokens.bdb: foul in a religious sense
tokens.kjv: defiled, [phrase] infamous, polluted(-tion), unclean.

tokens.bdb: pure (in a physical, chemical, ceremonial or moral sense)
tokens.kjv: clean, fair, pure(-ness).

tokens.bdb: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
tokens.kjv: acknowledge, acquaintance(-ted with), advise, answer, appoint, assuredly, be aware, (un-) awares, can(-not), certainly, comprehend, consider, [idiom] could they, cunning, declare, be diligent, (can, cause to) discern, discover, endued with, familiar friend, famous, feel, can have, be (ig-) norant, instruct, kinsfolk, kinsman, (cause to let, make) know, (come to give, have, take) knowledge, have (knowledge), (be, make, make to be, make self) known, [phrase] be learned, [phrase] lie by man, mark, perceive, privy to, [idiom] prognosticator, regard, have respect, skilful, shew, can (man of) skill, be sure, of a surety, teach, (can) tell, understand, have (understanding), [idiom] will be, wist, wit, wot.

tokens.bdb: intermission, i.e (specifically) the Sabbath
tokens.kjv: ([phrase] every) sabbath.

tokens.bdb: to veil from sight, i.e. conceal (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any ways, blind, dissembler, hide (self), secret (thing).

tokens.bdb: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
tokens.kjv: affliction, outward appearance, [phrase] before, [phrase] think best, colour, conceit, [phrase] be content, countenance, [phrase] displease, eye((-brow), (-d), -sight), face, [phrase] favour, fountain, furrow (from the margin), [idiom] him, [phrase] humble, knowledge, look, ([phrase] well), [idiom] me, open(-ly), [phrase] (not) please, presence, [phrase] regard, resemblance, sight, [idiom] thee, [idiom] them, [phrase] think, [idiom] us, well, [idiom] you(-rselves).
tokens.explanation: ayin — olho, olhos, aparência, fonte (de água), perspectiva

tokens.bdb: a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre
tokens.kjv: among(-st), [idiom] between, half, [idiom] (there-, where-), in(-to), middle, mid(-night), midst (among), [idiom] out (of), [idiom] through, [idiom] with(-in).
